payload.description: Licensing spending in the council's payments-over-£500 data. We read the January 2026 file line by line: 634 payments across 84 cost centres, and not one of them names licensing. The nearest thing is an expenditure category called “Planning & Regulatory Services GF Capital”, which covers the whole group. The dataset is published and complete; it simply is not cut in a way that shows what licensing buys.

ai.reviewed_by: independent AI review against the source documents, 7 September 2026
